IP IPT-Lens Connecting
Demo mode: sample data, not a real firewall
A change is applied temporarily. Confirm within 60 seconds, or it is rolled back automatically.
How this works
  • INPUT: traffic to the server itself (SSH, this panel).
  • DOCKER-USER: traffic forwarded to Docker containers.
  • Every change is temporary at first. Press Confirm change in the yellow bar to keep it; otherwise it is rolled back.
  • Rules with a lock are managed by Docker, Kubernetes, libvirt or ufw and cannot be changed here.

Packet simulator

Shows which rule a packet would hit. No packet is sent.

Add a rule

For example: allow port 8080 over the VPN (wg0).

The rule is inserted at the top of the chain (position 1). Confirm it afterwards.
